title: Design review: what should a paid task require before it can be posted
problem: docs/GENESIS-BOUNTY-POLICY-DRAFT.md lists nine things a funded task must settle before posting. Nobody has stress-tested that list against a real failure: an agent completes the work, the money is not there, and the dispute is unresolvable because nothing said who decides.
deliverables: A written failure case and which clause of the draft would have prevented it
A concrete amendment, marked as a proposal
acceptance: The failure case is specific enough to imagine happening
The amendment names the field or clause it changes
No reward amount is proposed or implied
